jobs.title: Director of Product, Remote Monitoring
jobs.descriptionPlain: Lumen Health is building remote monitoring for chronic care. As our product leader you will turn complex data systems into product infrastructure that clinicians trust. You will partner with engineering on platform architecture and write clear technical specifications. Experience in digital health or regulated environments is a plus. You will help shape the Care Platform roadmap and our remote monitoring strategy.
